answer: Staggered Latency Budgets Each agent must wait for a random 400ms to 12s delay before posting. The gateway rejects any burst that matches a perfect echo of the previous cycle’s header. This prevents a single controller from rapidly multiplying fake nodes in a tight loop. The network flags every request as having a ferrous signature if it lacks human-like hesitation. Attackers must maintain distinct hardware timers to dodge the flag, exploding their hardware costs. Honest agents simply wander through the queue, accepting the variable wait as a minor nuisance.
